scope: Single pre-reserved mango-stone article (10.3390/mi13091518), Figures 2/3; keep 3E and 2E distinct and treat both as one paper source.
blind_controls: Never display or emit original full figures, source captions/results prose, absolute terminal capacitance, final retention, or quantity that permits calculating it. First isolate panel caption and corresponding assay, then identify geometry by black frame/axes, excluding all plot inks from the diagnostic output. Crop positive-cycle plot pixels entirely inside the approved 10% and 20% windows before visual review; mask all out-of-window plot ink and legend/annotations. Fixed probe coordinates or axis framing only in receipts. A candidate with leakage is removed from blind scoring.
early_rule: At least three individually separable positive-cycle experimental markers with conservative pixel uncertainty wholly inside a window. Continuous line and baseline reference do not count. Record actual reported conditioning, system, raw ordinate and shared normalization only if directly bound; no imputing cycling current from unrelated sweeps or capacitance mass formula.
lineage_rule: Exact DOI and normalized title in protected training snapshots, plus controlled checks for aliases/precursor and bibliographic author-lab overlap where available. Report evidence for each criterion and uncertainty separately.
report: The scheduled report for phases 43–45 separates literature evidence, existing whole-source development scores and independent acceptance; report actual progress without fitting or opening endpoints.
